description.en: Ultra-fast OpenAI-compatible inference (up to ~2,000 tokens/s) with a free tier of roughly 1M tokens/day per model (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B); no credit card required.
description.zh-Hans: OpenAI 兼容的极速推理（可达约 2,000 tokens/秒），免费层每模型每天约 100 万 tokens（如 Llama 3.3 70B）；无需信用卡。

detail.en: Cerebras runs open LLMs on wafer-scale chips with very high throughput via an OpenAI-compatible API (base https://api.cerebras.ai/v1). The free tier provides roughly 1M tokens/day per model with per-model RPM/TPM/TPD limits (values per the official rate-limits doc); hitting a limit returns 429. No credit card is required; the paid Developer tier offers about 10x higher limits.
detail.zh-Hans: Cerebras 使用晶圆级芯片托管开源 LLM，通过 OpenAI 兼容 API（https://api.cerebras.ai/v1）提供极高吞吐。免费层每模型每天约 100 万 tokens，并按模型设置 RPM/TPM/TPD 限速（数值见官方 rate-limits 文档）；超限返回 429。无需信用卡；付费 Developer 层限速约为免费层 10 倍。

freeLimit.en: Free tier: roughly 1M tokens/day per model (plus per-model RPM/TPM limits); no credit card required. Check the official rate-limits doc for current values.
freeLimit.zh-Hans: 免费层约每模型每天 100 万 tokens（另按模型设 RPM/TPM 限速）；无需信用卡；当前数值以官方 rate-limits 文档为准。

registrationRestriction.en: Sign up with email; no credit card required. Rate limits are per organization/API key and model.
registrationRestriction.zh-Hans: 邮箱注册即可，无需信用卡；限速按组织/API Key 与模型计。

model.en: Free-tier models (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen3 and other open models)
model.zh-Hans: 免费层模型（如 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen3 等开源模型）

quota.zh-Hans: 免费，每模型约 100 万 tokens/天

frequency.en: RPM/TPM/TPD per model; see official doc
frequency.zh-Hans: 按模型设 RPM/TPM/TPD，见官方文档
